prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 异常长值 · 标签列中的一个长值 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "城市" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 230px
  col 2: header "级别" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 368px
  col 3: header "人口（万）" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 77px
  col 4: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 200px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 720px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 719px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"对比各城市的级别、人口和备注，并呈现一个名称及级别说明明显较长的特殊案例。","reading":"读者先按城市定位行，再横向查看级别、人口和备注；比较人口时可沿数字列纵向扫描。长城市名所在行较高，适合同时容纳该行级别说明的换行。","groups":["城市和级别共同标识及描述每条记录；两列的长值出现在同一行，可以共享该行增加的高度。","人口是便于纵向比较的数值列；备注提供补充语境。"],"keep_intact":["人口数字及其千位分隔符","简短级别值，如一线、新一线","城市名称应保持易于连续阅读，避免过窄导致逐字换行"],"may_wrap":["特别长的城市名称可在汉字之间换行","长级别说明可按自然语义位置换行","备注中的说明文字可自然换行"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [200, 260, 98, 161] · table 720×278px · row heights [36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2B: widths [251, 245, 98, 125] · table 720×301px · row heights [36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 83, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r2C: widths [235, 245, 98, 141] · table 720×278px · row heights [36, 36, 36, 36, 36, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"人口列紧凑且表头、数字完整；长城市名、级别说明和备注都控制在两行，特殊行仍作为一个整体易于横向阅读。备注换行位置也较自然。","problems":"城市名第一行较长，第二行只剩较短的地名尾部；级别说明在“调整”中间换行，阅读节奏略受影响。","cause":"城市列200px使长名称在靠近尾部处折行；级别列260px的可用文字宽度使“调整”跨行。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"城市列足够宽，长城市名保持一行，便于连续辨认；人口列仍便于纵向比较。","problems":"备注被挤成三行，末行只有一个“查”字，特殊行因此明显增高，且城市与级别列下方出现较多空白。","cause":"城市列251px占用较多宽度，备注列仅125px，其文字可用宽度不足以在两行内容纳长备注。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"特殊行的三个长值均为两行，表格高度紧凑；人口列完整，备注也比r2B更易读。","problems":"城市名末行仅有“什市”，形成明显短尾；级别说明在“调整”中间换行。两处短尾削弱了特殊行的阅读节奏。","cause":"城市列235px接近单行所需宽度但仍不足；级别列245px使长说明在该位置折行。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[211,259,98,151],"change":"以r2A为基础，将城市列加宽11px，备注列保持足够空间容纳两行，微调级别列以改善特殊行的整体比例。"},{"name":"semantic-wrap","widths":[190,277,98,154],"change":"把部分宽度从城市列转给级别列，尝试让级别说明在更自然的位置换行；城市名仍有空间分成易读的两行，备注保留两行空间。"},{"name":"city-intact","widths":[251,218,98,152],"change":"保留r2B中城市名单行的优点，将宽度从级别列转给备注，尝试让级别和备注均以两行呈现，消除备注孤字。"}]}
